title: Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho Baba Kaha'n
body:
Sitam Ki Zad Pey Sakina Ney Ye Dua'a Ki Hai,
Meri Tarah Na Koi Ho Yateem Merey Khuda,
Kisi Sey Chhootey Na Apna Koi Azeez Kabhi,
K Jis Tarah Main Kaha'n Hoo'n Merey Baba Hai'n Kaha'n,
Kah Rahi Thi Ye Ro Ro Sakina - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho Baba Kaha'n,
Ho Gaya Ab To Dushwaar Jeena - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho Baba Kaha'n,
Zalimo'n Ne Tama'nchey Bhi Marey,
Chheen Kar Ley Gaye Gaushwarey,
Chain Milta Hai Ab To Kahi'n Na - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho....
Har Qadam Par Satatey Hai'n Zalim,
Hamko Qaidi Banatey Hai'n Zalim,
Ab Taras Ham Pey Khata Koi Na - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho....
Nee'nd Bhi Mujhko Aati Nahi'n Hai,
Aap Key Bin Sulati Nahi'n Hai,
Chhut Gaya Aap Ka Jab Sey Seena - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho....
Kya Isi Ko Hai'n Kahtey Yateemi,
Jo Ajal Ka Hai Kaam Qadeemi,
Sar Sey Saya Bhi Aapka Chheena - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho....
Ja Key Maqtal Se Wapas Na Aaye,
Ley Gayi Hai Qaza Sabko Haye,
Almadad Kis Ko Boley Yateema - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho....
Merey Ammoo Kaha'n Par Ho Aao,
Kuchh Taras Meri Ghurbat Pey Khao,
Ab Mai'n Maa'ngoo'ngi Paani Kabhi Na - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho....
Kesi Mushkil Hai Mujh Par Ye Aayi,
Ya Ali Kariye Mushkil Kushayi,
Hai A'ngoothi Kahi'n Par Nageena - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho....
Qaid Khaney Me'n Turbat Baneygi,
Aapki Beti Jisme'n Raheygi,
Ab Na Hoga Naseeb Madeena - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho....
Khoon-e-dil Se 'Raees' Likheyga,
Khoon Aa'nkho'n Se Us Dam Baheyga,
Ro Key Jis Dam Kaheygi Sakina - Merey Baba Kaha'n Ho....
